card.name: Dollar sign before amounts or commands
card.fires_on: The dollar sign character, either right before a money amount (often after US) or as a shell prompt at the start of a command line.

modes.label: Currency amount
modes.description: Dollar sign directly before a price or cost figure, often after "US".
modes.example: the fact that the Sega Saturn was US<<$>>100 more costly than the PlayStation

modes.label: Shell prompt
modes.description: Dollar sign used as the command prompt before a typed terminal command.
modes.example: When you use the command with -w it displays only the number of the section where a given command is described. <<$>> man -w open /usr/share/man
